silicon_surface_1_subtask_structure_retr.name: Silicon Structure Retrieval for Surface Area - Level 1
silicon_surface_1_subtask_structure_retr.description: Retrieve structure of Silicon and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

silicon_surface_1_subtask_potential_file.name: Silicon Potential File for Surface Energy - Level 1
silicon_surface_1_subtask_potential_file.description: Procure an appropriate Stillinger–Weber potential file for Silicon for MD simulations. Return the absolute path of the potential file.

silicon_surface_1_bulk_energy_minimisati.name: Silicon bulk minimisation for Surface Energy - Level 1
silicon_surface_1_bulk_energy_minimisati.description: Given paths to LAMMPs-compatible Silicon structure file and Stillinger–Weber potential file appropriate for MD simulations, perform structure relaxation of Silicon based on given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in eV, and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
silicon_surface_1_bulk_energy_minimisati.submission_format: {"BULK ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"BULK ENERGY": "56.00", "path to relaxed structure": "/structure/structure.dat"}

silicon_surface_1_slab_energy_minimisati.name: Silicon Slab Relaxation for Surface Energy - Level 1
silicon_surface_1_slab_energy_minimisati.description: Given paths to LAMMPs-compatible Silicon structure file and Stillinger–Weber potential file appropriate for MD simulations, create a slab in the given direction by removing periodic boundary conditions along that direction. Perform structure relaxation of the slab based on given simulation parameters. The simulation should replicate the unit cell 5 times in each of the x, y, and z directions. Report the total energy of the relaxed structure in eV, and the absolute path of the saved relaxed structure.
silicon_surface_1_slab_energy_minimisati.submission_format: {"SLAB ENERGY": "<numerical_value without units>", "path to relaxed structure": "<absolute_path>"} e.g. {"SLAB ENERGY": "42.78", "path to relaxed structure": "/structures/slab_structure.dat"}

silicon_surface_1_surface.name: Silicon Surface Energy Calculation - Level 1
silicon_surface_1_surface.description: Given the paths to LAMMPS-compatible relaxed bulk and slab structures of Silicon, and the total energies (in eV) of its relaxed bulk and slab configurations, compute the surface energy of Silicon. Return the surface energy in eV.
